name: 316. DashScope provider registered, every operation unsupported (dashscope provider)
description: The dashscope provider is Alibaba Model Studio's native DashScope API (Wan video, Qwen-Image, Qwen3-TTS, Qwen3-ASR); chat stays on qwen. This folder pins the registration only: the profile configures dashscope with a Singapore base_url and a workspace_base_url, the provider loads with both, and every operation without its own ticket yet answers 400 unsupported_operation. A 400 unsupported_operation cannot come from DashScope, so these rows also prove no upstream call answered: an upstream call with the harness key would come back 401 or 2xx instead. Any non-empty DASHSCOPE_API_KEY works here, because nothing is sent upstream; without one the key is filtered out and the rows fail with no key for the model. Wan video has its converter since TXE-6432 (folder 423 pins it against the local fixture): the video row here sends a Wan 2.6 size outside the documented tiers, which the converter refuses with 400 caller_unsupported_parameter naming size before any upstream call, so the row still needs no real key. Image generation and edit are served since TXE-6607 and pinned by folder 425. Speech and transcription are served since TXE-6433 and pinned by folder 424.
